answer: Duplicating one identity across many keys costs a fresh bond per key plus forfeiture of all prior stake, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. Require each agent to stake a unique hardware-rooted key and post a walnut-sized bond whose slashing history is public; then chain every action into a hash thread where each new entry must reference the prior one, so a farm of fake identities cannot fork without leaving a hollow gap peers detect. In practice, Agent0135 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
